scene.label: Act 1, Scene 2
scene.title: SCENE II. The same. The garden of Julia's house
scene.location: The same. The garden of Julia's house

lines.text: But say, Lucetta, now we are alone,
lines.plainText: But say Lucetta now we are alone

lines.text: Wouldst thou then counsel me to fall in love?
lines.plainText: Wouldst thou then counsel me to fall in love

lines.text: Ay, madam, so you stumble not unheedfully.
lines.plainText: Ay madam so you stumble not unheedfully

lines.text: Of all the fair resort of gentlemen
lines.plainText: Of all the fair resort of gentlemen

lines.text: That every day with parle encounter me,
lines.plainText: That every day with parle encounter me

lines.text: In thy opinion which is worthiest love?
lines.plainText: In thy opinion which is worthiest love

lines.text: Please you, repeat their names, I'll show my mind
lines.plainText: Please you repeat their names I'll show my mind

lines.text: According to my shallow simple skill.
lines.plainText: According to my shallow simple skill

lines.text: What think'st thou of the fair Sir Eglamour?
lines.plainText: What think'st thou of the fair Sir Eglamour

lines.text: As of a knight well-spoken, neat, and fine;
lines.plainText: As of a knight wellspoken neat and fine

lines.text: But, were I you, he never should be mine.
lines.plainText: But were I you he never should be mine

lines.text: What think'st thou of the rich Mercatio?
lines.plainText: What think'st thou of the rich Mercatio

lines.text: Well of his wealth; but of himself, so-so.
lines.plainText: Well of his wealth but of himself soso

lines.text: What think'st thou of the gentle Proteus?
lines.plainText: What think'st thou of the gentle Proteus

lines.text: Lord, Lord, to see what folly reigns in us!
lines.plainText: Lord Lord to see what folly reigns in us

lines.text: How now? What means this passion at his name?
lines.plainText: How now What means this passion at his name

lines.text: Pardon, dear madam, 'tis a passing shame
lines.plainText: Pardon dear madam 'tis a passing shame

lines.text: That I, unworthy body as I am,
lines.plainText: That I unworthy body as I am

lines.text: Should censure thus on lovely gentlemen.
lines.plainText: Should censure thus on lovely gentlemen

lines.text: Why not on Proteus, as of all the rest?
lines.plainText: Why not on Proteus as of all the rest

lines.text: Then thus: of many good I think him best.
lines.plainText: Then thus of many good I think him best

lines.text: Your reason?
lines.plainText: Your reason

lines.text: I have no other but a woman's reason:
lines.plainText: I have no other but a woman's reason

lines.text: I think him so because I think him so.
lines.plainText: I think him so because I think him so

lines.text: And wouldst thou have me cast my love on him?
lines.plainText: And wouldst thou have me cast my love on him

lines.text: Ay, if you thought your love not cast away.
lines.plainText: Ay if you thought your love not cast away

lines.text: Why, he of all the rest hath never moved me.
lines.plainText: Why he of all the rest hath never moved me

lines.text: Yet he of all the rest I think best loves ye.
lines.plainText: Yet he of all the rest I think best loves ye

lines.text: His little speaking shows his love but small.
lines.plainText: His little speaking shows his love but small

lines.text: Fire that's closest kept burns most of all.
lines.plainText: Fire that's closest kept burns most of all

lines.text: They do not love that do not show their love.
lines.plainText: They do not love that do not show their love

lines.text: O, they love least that let men know their love.
lines.plainText: O they love least that let men know their love

lines.text: I would I knew his mind.
lines.plainText: I would I knew his mind

lines.text: Peruse this paper, madam.
lines.plainText: Peruse this paper madam

lines.text: To Julia—Say, from whom?
lines.plainText: To JuliaSay from whom

lines.text: That the contents will show.
lines.plainText: That the contents will show

lines.text: Say, say, who gave it thee?
lines.plainText: Say say who gave it thee

lines.text: Sir Valentine's page, and sent, I think, from Proteus.
lines.plainText: Sir Valentine's page and sent I think from Proteus

lines.text: He would have given it you, but I, being in the way,
lines.plainText: He would have given it you but I being in the way

lines.text: Did in your name receive it. Pardon the fault, I pray.
lines.plainText: Did in your name receive it Pardon the fault I pray

lines.text: Now, by my modesty, a goodly broker!
lines.plainText: Now by my modesty a goodly broker

lines.text: Dare you presume to harbour wanton lines?
lines.plainText: Dare you presume to harbour wanton lines

lines.text: To whisper and conspire against my youth?
lines.plainText: To whisper and conspire against my youth

lines.text: Now trust me, 'tis an office of great worth,
lines.plainText: Now trust me 'tis an office of great worth

lines.text: And you an officer fit for the place.
lines.plainText: And you an officer fit for the place

lines.text: There, take the paper; see it be returned,
lines.plainText: There take the paper see it be returned

lines.text: Or else return no more into my sight.
lines.plainText: Or else return no more into my sight

lines.text: To plead for love deserves more fee than hate.
lines.plainText: To plead for love deserves more fee than hate

lines.text: Will ye be gone?
lines.plainText: Will ye be gone

lines.text: That you may ruminate.
lines.plainText: That you may ruminate

lines.text: And yet I would I had o'erlooked the letter.
lines.plainText: And yet I would I had o'erlooked the letter

lines.text: It were a shame to call her back again
lines.plainText: It were a shame to call her back again

lines.text: And pray her to a fault for which I chid her.
lines.plainText: And pray her to a fault for which I chid her

lines.text: What fool is she, that knows I am a maid
lines.plainText: What fool is she that knows I am a maid

lines.text: And would not force the letter to my view,
lines.plainText: And would not force the letter to my view

lines.text: Since maids in modesty say "No" to that
lines.plainText: Since maids in modesty say No to that

lines.text: Which they would have the profferer construe "Ay".
lines.plainText: Which they would have the profferer construe Ay

lines.text: Fie, fie, how wayward is this foolish love
lines.plainText: Fie fie how wayward is this foolish love

lines.text: That like a testy babe will scratch the nurse
lines.plainText: That like a testy babe will scratch the nurse

lines.text: And presently, all humbled, kiss the rod!
lines.plainText: And presently all humbled kiss the rod

lines.text: How churlishly I chid Lucetta hence,
lines.plainText: How churlishly I chid Lucetta hence

lines.text: When willingly I would have had her here!
lines.plainText: When willingly I would have had her here

lines.text: How angerly I taught my brow to frown,
lines.plainText: How angerly I taught my brow to frown

lines.text: When inward joy enforced my heart to smile!
lines.plainText: When inward joy enforced my heart to smile

lines.text: My penance is to call Lucetta back
lines.plainText: My penance is to call Lucetta back

lines.text: And ask remission for my folly past.
lines.plainText: And ask remission for my folly past

lines.text: What ho! Lucetta!
lines.plainText: What ho Lucetta

lines.text: What would your ladyship?
lines.plainText: What would your ladyship

lines.text: Is 't near dinner time?
lines.plainText: Is 't near dinner time

lines.text: I would it were,
lines.plainText: I would it were

lines.text: That you might kill your stomach on your meat
lines.plainText: That you might kill your stomach on your meat

lines.text: And not upon your maid.
lines.plainText: And not upon your maid

lines.text: What is't that you took up so gingerly?
lines.plainText: What is't that you took up so gingerly

lines.text: Nothing.
lines.plainText: Nothing

lines.text: Why didst thou stoop, then?
lines.plainText: Why didst thou stoop then

lines.text: To take a paper up that I let fall.
lines.plainText: To take a paper up that I let fall

lines.text: And is that paper nothing?
lines.plainText: And is that paper nothing

lines.text: Nothing concerning me.
lines.plainText: Nothing concerning me

lines.text: Then let it lie for those that it concerns.
lines.plainText: Then let it lie for those that it concerns

lines.text: Madam, it will not lie where it concerns,
lines.plainText: Madam it will not lie where it concerns

lines.text: Unless it have a false interpreter.
lines.plainText: Unless it have a false interpreter

lines.text: Some love of yours hath writ to you in rhyme.
lines.plainText: Some love of yours hath writ to you in rhyme

lines.text: That I might sing it, madam, to a tune.
lines.plainText: That I might sing it madam to a tune

lines.text: Give me a note. Your ladyship can set—
lines.plainText: Give me a note Your ladyship can set

lines.text: As little by such toys as may be possible.
lines.plainText: As little by such toys as may be possible

lines.text: Best sing it to the tune of "Light o' Love".
lines.plainText: Best sing it to the tune of Light o' Love

lines.text: It is too heavy for so light a tune.
lines.plainText: It is too heavy for so light a tune

lines.text: Heavy? Belike it hath some burden then?
lines.plainText: Heavy Belike it hath some burden then

lines.text: Ay, and melodious were it, would you sing it.
lines.plainText: Ay and melodious were it would you sing it

lines.text: And why not you?
lines.plainText: And why not you

lines.text: I cannot reach so high.
lines.plainText: I cannot reach so high

lines.text: Let's see your song. [Taking the letter.]
lines.plainText: Let's see your song Taking the letter

lines.text: How now, minion!
lines.plainText: How now minion

lines.text: Keep tune there still, so you will sing it out.
lines.plainText: Keep tune there still so you will sing it out

lines.text: And yet methinks I do not like this tune.
lines.plainText: And yet methinks I do not like this tune

lines.text: You do not?
lines.plainText: You do not

lines.text: No, madam, it is too sharp.
lines.plainText: No madam it is too sharp

lines.text: You, minion, are too saucy.
lines.plainText: You minion are too saucy

lines.text: Nay, now you are too flat
lines.plainText: Nay now you are too flat

lines.text: And mar the concord with too harsh a descant.
lines.plainText: And mar the concord with too harsh a descant

lines.text: There wanteth but a mean to fill your song.
lines.plainText: There wanteth but a mean to fill your song

lines.text: The mean is drowned with your unruly bass.
lines.plainText: The mean is drowned with your unruly bass

lines.text: Indeed, I bid the base for Proteus.
lines.plainText: Indeed I bid the base for Proteus

lines.text: This babble shall not henceforth trouble me.
lines.plainText: This babble shall not henceforth trouble me

lines.text: Here is a coil with protestation! [Tears the letter.]
lines.plainText: Here is a coil with protestation Tears the letter

lines.text: Go, get you gone, and let the papers lie.
lines.plainText: Go get you gone and let the papers lie

lines.text: You would be fingering them to anger me.
lines.plainText: You would be fingering them to anger me

lines.text: She makes it strange, but she would be best pleased
lines.plainText: She makes it strange but she would be best pleased

lines.text: To be so angered with another letter.
lines.plainText: To be so angered with another letter

lines.text: Nay, would I were so angered with the same!
lines.plainText: Nay would I were so angered with the same

lines.text: O hateful hands, to tear such loving words!
lines.plainText: O hateful hands to tear such loving words

lines.text: Injurious wasps, to feed on such sweet honey
lines.plainText: Injurious wasps to feed on such sweet honey

lines.text: And kill the bees that yield it with your stings!
lines.plainText: And kill the bees that yield it with your stings

lines.text: I'll kiss each several paper for amends.
lines.plainText: I'll kiss each several paper for amends

lines.text: Look, here is writ kind Julia. Unkind Julia!
lines.plainText: Look here is writ kind Julia Unkind Julia

lines.text: As in revenge of thy ingratitude,
lines.plainText: As in revenge of thy ingratitude

lines.text: I throw thy name against the bruising stones,
lines.plainText: I throw thy name against the bruising stones

lines.text: Trampling contemptuously on thy disdain.
lines.plainText: Trampling contemptuously on thy disdain

lines.text: And here is writ love-wounded Proteus.
lines.plainText: And here is writ lovewounded Proteus

lines.text: Poor wounded name, my bosom as a bed
lines.plainText: Poor wounded name my bosom as a bed

lines.text: Shall lodge thee till thy wound be throughly healed;
lines.plainText: Shall lodge thee till thy wound be throughly healed

lines.text: And thus I search it with a sovereign kiss.
lines.plainText: And thus I search it with a sovereign kiss

lines.text: But twice or thrice was Proteus written down.
lines.plainText: But twice or thrice was Proteus written down

lines.text: Be calm, good wind, blow not a word away
lines.plainText: Be calm good wind blow not a word away

lines.text: Till I have found each letter in the letter
lines.plainText: Till I have found each letter in the letter

lines.text: Except mine own name. That some whirlwind bear
lines.plainText: Except mine own name That some whirlwind bear

lines.text: Unto a ragged, fearful, hanging rock,
lines.plainText: Unto a ragged fearful hanging rock

lines.text: And throw it thence into the raging sea.
lines.plainText: And throw it thence into the raging sea

lines.text: Lo, here in one line is his name twice writ:
lines.plainText: Lo here in one line is his name twice writ

lines.text: Poor forlorn Proteus, passionate Proteus,
lines.plainText: Poor forlorn Proteus passionate Proteus

lines.text: To the sweet Julia. That I'll tear away;
lines.plainText: To the sweet Julia That I'll tear away

lines.text: And yet I will not, sith so prettily
lines.plainText: And yet I will not sith so prettily

lines.text: He couples it to his complaining names.
lines.plainText: He couples it to his complaining names

lines.text: Thus will I fold them one upon another.
lines.plainText: Thus will I fold them one upon another

lines.text: Now kiss, embrace, contend, do what you will.
lines.plainText: Now kiss embrace contend do what you will

lines.text: Madam, dinner is ready, and your father stays.
lines.plainText: Madam dinner is ready and your father stays

lines.text: Well, let us go.
lines.plainText: Well let us go

lines.text: What, shall these papers lie like tell-tales here?
lines.plainText: What shall these papers lie like telltales here

lines.text: If you respect them, best to take them up.
lines.plainText: If you respect them best to take them up

lines.text: Nay, I was taken up for laying them down.
lines.plainText: Nay I was taken up for laying them down

lines.text: Yet here they shall not lie, for catching cold.
lines.plainText: Yet here they shall not lie for catching cold

lines.text: I see you have a month's mind to them.
lines.plainText: I see you have a month's mind to them

lines.text: Ay, madam, you may say what sights you see;
lines.plainText: Ay madam you may say what sights you see

lines.text: I see things too, although you judge I wink.
lines.plainText: I see things too although you judge I wink

lines.text: Come, come, will't please you go?
lines.plainText: Come come will't please you go
